prompts.head:
Use case: stylized-concept, modular pixel portrait game asset.
Create ONE isolated bald adult male head and neck, straight front view, for a baseball manager character portrait. Reference image 1 provides the attractive detailed pixel rendering style; reference image 2 provides the fine pixel portrait aesthetic, NOT identities to copy.
This is a NEW ORIGINAL character template, not any existing game or manga character. Natural adult proportions and pleasant softly angular athletic face, ears visible, clean jaw, no exaggerated chin. Head and neck only, no shoulders.
Leave feature areas BLANK: no eyes, no eyebrows, no nose, no mouth, no hair, no beard, no cap, no accessories. Subtle planes at cheeks/jaw and ear details are okay. Face is a neutral warm peach skin material, THREE discrete skin shadow tones plus highlight. Avoid smooth gradients.
Crisp deliberate square pixel clusters: art should resemble a native 96x128 pixel portrait enlarged nearest-neighbor, not brush strokes or vector and not big chunky chibi. Symmetric front facing neutral head shape. Head fills roughly x26%-74%, top10% to chin74%, neck to90%. Center at50%. Head slightly wider at temples, smoothly stepped pixel outline, attractive natural adult proportions.
Exact transparent background, no checkerboard painted in, no gray/white ground. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, objects or shadow outside head. Keep solid clean alpha border.
This head is a reusable separate layer; face features and hair will be supplied separately. Do not pre-add eyes or hair.
prompts.bodies:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a PRODUCTION SPRITE ATLAS of exactly SIX separate headless baseball player TORSO BUSTS in a 3 column x 2 row regular grid, transparent background. Each cell same size, no borders or labels. Reference 1 is the detailed pixel style; reference 2 is the separate adult head that will later be attached and MUST NOT be included here.
ONLY torsos from base of NECK down to lower ribs; no head, no face, no hair, no hats, no hands. Front-facing. Natural adult athletic proportions, detailed attractive retro RPG pixel art, clear visible square pixel clusters about native 96x80 per cell. No smooth gradients or antialiasing. Center neckline at x50% y15% of each cell. All torsos end at exactly y90%. Deep teal green baseball jersey, simple white V collar and white short sleeve cuffs, dark teal 3-tone fabric shadow, no buttons needed, no text or logos. Transparent V-neck opening so a separate neck can appear behind the jersey. No exposed skin anywhere, all cloth. Sleeve hems and lower cropped edges clean.
Six physique silhouettes ordered left-to-right top-to-bottom:
1 normal balanced athletic shoulders and slim muscular trunk
2 power heavy: thick arms and solid muscular broad chest, wide core, flat abdomen, NOT round obese or potbelly
3 slender: visibly narrow shoulders and thin upper arms, slim torso
4 broad-shouldered: exceptionally broad squared shoulders narrowing sharply to slim waist, distinct inverted triangle, not same as heavy
5 tall: longer trunk, medium-narrow shoulders, narrow extended sleeves, maintain crop baseline
6 compact: shorter compact solid torso, moderate shoulders, visibly short sleeves, narrower overall than normal
Keep all six jersey style identical, fixed light upper left. Pixel palette about 12 colors, no lighting halo or texture. No background, no ground shadow, no decorations. Adequate transparent gutters between all items, every torso fully inside cell. Never include assembled head.
prompts.features:
Use case: stylized-concept. A modular facial-feature SPRITE ATLAS for an original handsome adult male baseball player portrait, matching the finely pixelated adult portrait reference. TRANSPARENT background, no full faces, no heads.
Exactly 6 columns and 4 rows of isolated parts, regular grid, 24 items total, no lines, no labels. Every item centered inside its grid cell with ample transparent space. This atlas is to be cut into independent parts and composited onto the blank head reference. Front view, natural adult male anatomy, subtle rather than caricature. Crisp pixel clusters, native scale about 30x12 per eye pair, not painterly.
Row 1: SIX PAIRS OF EYES only, both left and right eyes in each cell. White sclera, BLUE irises and black pupils for color swap. Variants: balanced almond / narrower calm / rounder friendly / upward outer corners / heavy upper lids / gently drooping outer corners. Neutral character traits, not emotion expressions. Equal spacing within every pair, horizontal and centered, no eyebrows or skin patches.
Row 2: SIX PAIRS OF EYEBROWS only in dark brown, balanced / thick straight / thin straight / angled / soft arch / short broad. Equal spacing and overall width matching eyes, no eyes.
Row 3: SIX NOSES only, small subtle original adult pixel nose shading in warm peach and medium brown: straight / rounded tip / wider / short / narrow long / broad bridge. Avoid realistic photos. No mouth or eyes.
Row 4: SIX MOUTHS only, relaxed closed lips with muted warm rosy brown and dark short division line: straight neutral / soft smile / fuller / thin / asymmetric slight grin / wider relaxed. No chin or beard.
All 24 independent parts cleanly separated. Actual transparent PNG, background RGB black with alpha0, no background tint or glow. Flat 3-4 color ramps, hard pixel edges. No text, logos, watermark, icons, frames, or other features.
prompts.equipment:
Create a clean transparent pixel-art SPRITE ATLAS of 16 separate facial accessories for an original adult male baseball game portrait, in exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, equal cells and generous empty gutters. Match the fine retro pixel cluster style of attached hair atlas, but do not repeat its random background artifacts. NO faces, NO heads, NO skin, NO mannequins. Every object straight front view and symmetrical unless described. Crisp dark outlines, discrete 3-tone shading, no gradient, glow, lettering or branding.
Read row by row:
Row1: 1 small short chin beard only; 2 thin jawline beard as an open U shape; 3 short full beard including moustache and open transparent mouth area; 4 full bushier beard with open transparent mouth area.
Row2: 5 moustache plus small goatee isolated; 6 thin round dark eyeglasses with completely transparent lenses; 7 thin rectangular dark eyeglasses transparent lenses; 8 brown round-corner spectacles transparent lenses.
Row3: 9 semi-rimless spectacles transparent lenses; 10 compact charcoal sport sunglasses; 11 dark blue sport sunglasses; 12 black eye patch over wearer's left eye with a narrow diagonal strap (one patch only).
Row4: 13 pair of short rectangular under-eye black grease strips; 14 pair of longer under-eye black strips; 15 pair of uneven slightly smudged black strips made of clear pixels; 16 plain dark teal baseball batting helmet, isolated with no head or face inside, one ear guard.
Beards dark brown, no skin pixels. Glasses frames charcoal 2 native pixels thick and clear bridge. Each glasses piece contains BOTH lenses. All pieces front view fit adult head. Actual transparency: all pixels outside objects zero alpha, not opaque black and not checkerboard. No text, numbers, watermark, separator lines or grid. Keep every item wholly inside its cell.
